preconditions.description: The number of operators n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and len(line) <= 20 for line in operators)
preconditions.description: Each operator line must be a non-empty string of no more than 20 lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(any(op in line for op in ['typedef', 'typeof']) for line in operators)
preconditions.description: Each operator must be either a 'typedef' or 'typeof' command.

postconditions.description: The output must match the expected output for each 'typeof' operator.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output, str) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output for 'typeof' operators must be a string representing the type.
